rationale: The user supplied and corrected an existing INTERNAL/TABLE source whose Donor Information table contains Name, Category, and Amount. The directory exposes three generic editor mappings: Entry Field 1 is required, while Entry Fields 2 and 3 are optional and may point at any supported column in the selected table. An opt-in display formatter uses the TABLE header type—not cell-value inference—to add locale grouping and a literal currency prefix to any mapped number column. Optional category metadata remains an independent generated TABLE because it has separate ownership and editing cadence.
acceptedValueShapes: donorData: native datasource object containing the configured Donor Information table
donorData: selected table object containing header, rows, and optional connectors
categoryData: native datasource object containing one configured category table
categoryData: selected category table object containing header, rows, and optional connectors

behavior.unbound: an unbound donorData picker shows explicit editor guidance; an unbound categoryData picker keeps derived categories in alphabetical order with no description
behavior.boundEmpty: a bound empty donor source shows the configured empty-state message and never substitutes synthetic rows
behavior.invalidRows: rows without a readable mapped Entry Field 1 or category are skipped; invalid required table/mapping combinations show a stable configuration state
behavior.fieldMapping: read Entry Fields 1, 2, and 3 plus category and sort values from editor-configured column names; blank optional mappings hide their fields
behavior.numberFormatting: when enabled, add locale-aware grouping and the configured literal prefix only to mapped fields whose selected/native TABLE header type is number; leave text columns, invalid number cells, and headerless row-array values raw
behavior.categoryJoin: normalize category keys for case, accents, and whitespace; first duplicate metadata row wins; numeric order wins and original row index is the fallback
behavior.categoryPresentation: always make the active metadata description available above donor rows and optionally repeat it beneath category-button labels; the two placements have independent typography and color settings
behavior.complexCells: render primitives directly; a deliberately mapped structured date may contribute its date string and a mapped filePicker-like value may contribute only a non-empty name; unsupported objects are omitted rather than stringified
behavior.ordering: ALL is first in manual mode; metadata-listed donor categories follow numeric or source-row order, unmatched donor categories append alphabetically, and metadata-only empty categories are omitted
behavior.pagination: page size is directory columns times configured entries per column from one through twenty; preserve category/page across live updates when valid and clamp or reset deterministically otherwise
